## Umbral Dragon, Great Wyrm (CR 22)

**XP** 615,000  
 CE Colossal dragon (extraplanar)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +40; **Aura** frightful presence (360 ft., DC 32)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 39, touch 0, flat-footed 39 (-2 Dex, +39 natural, -8 size)  
 **hp** 420 (29d12+232)  
 **Fort** +24, **Ref** +14, **Will** +24  
 **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** cold, death effects, negative energy, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 33  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)  
 **Melee** bite +35 (4d8+21/19–20 plus energy drain), 2 claws +35 (4d6+14/19-20 plus energy drain), tail slap +33 (4d6+21) and 2 wings +33 (2d8+7)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (70-ft. cone, 24d8 neg. energy, DC 32), create shadows, crush (4d8+21, DC 32), energy drain (1 level, DC 32), shadow breath (12 Str), tail sweep (2d8+19, DC 32)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 29th; concentration +37)  

 At will—*[darkness](../../magic/spells/darkness.md)*, *[project image](../../magic/spells/project-image.md)* (DC 25), *[shadow walk](../../magic/spells/shadow-walk.md)*, *[vampiric touch](../../magic/spells/vampiric-touch.md)*  
3/day—*[finger of death](../../magic/spells/finger-of-death.md)* (DC 25), s*hades* (DC 27)  

 **Spells Known** (CL 19th; concentration +27)  

 9th (4/day)—*[suffocation, mass](../../magic/spells/suffocation-mass.md)* (DC 27), *[wish](../../magic/spells/wish.md)*  
 8th (7/day)—*[horrid wilting](../../magic/spells/horrid-wilting.md)* (DC 26), *[screen](../../magic/spells/screen.md)*, *[trap the soul](../../magic/spells/trap-the-soul.md)* (DC 26)  
7th (7/day)—*[destruction](../../magic/spells/destruction.md)* (DC 25), *[limited wish](../../magic/spells/limited-wish.md)*, *[waves of exhaustion](../../magic/spells/waves-of-exhaustion.md)*  
6th (7/day)—*[harm](../../magic/spells/harm.md)* (DC 24), *[mislead](../../magic/spells/mislead.md)*, *[veil](../../magic/spells/veil.md)* (DC 24)  
5th (7/day)—*[greater command](../../magic/spells/command-greater.md)* (DC 23), *[slay living](../../magic/spells/slay-living.md)* (DC 23), *[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*, *[unhallow](../../magic/spells/unhallow.md)*  
4th (7/day)—*[enervation](../../magic/spells/enervation.md)*, *[inflict critical wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-critical-wounds.md)* (DC 22), *[phantasmal killer](../../magic/spells/phantasmal-killer.md)* (DC 22), *[unholy blight](../../magic/spells/unholy-blight.md)* (DC 22)  
3rd (7/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*, *[inflict serious wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-serious-wounds.md)* (DC 21), *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 21)  
2nd (7/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[blur](../../magic/spells/blur.md)*, *[command undead](../../magic/spells/command-undead.md)* (DC 20), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[web](../../magic/spells/web.md)* (DC 20)  
1st (7/day)—*[inflict light wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-light-wounds.md)* (DC 19), *[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 19), *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*, *[reduce person](../../magic/spells/reduce-person.md)* (DC 19), *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*  
0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[bleed](../../magic/spells/bleed.md)* (DC 18), *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[disrupt undead](../../magic/spells/disrupt-undead.md)* (DC 18), *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[ray of frost](../../magic/spells/ray-of-frost.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 39, **Dex** 6, **Con** 27, **Int** 26, **Wis** 27, **Cha** 26  
 **Base Atk** +29; **CMB** +51; **CMD** 59 (63 vs trip)  
 **Feats** Bleeding Critical, Blinding Critical, Critical Focus, Flyby Attack, Greater Vital Strike, Hover, Improved Critical (bite, claws), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Multiattack, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Stealth), Snatch, Vital Strike  
 **Skills** Appraise +40, Bluff +40, Diplomacy +40, Fly +14, Knowledge (arcana, history, local, planes, religion) +40, Perception +40, Sense Motive +40, Spellcraft +40, Stealth +20, Survival +40  
 **Languages** Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Undercommon, 5 more  
 **SQ** ghost bane, umbral scion  

**Special Abilities**

 **Breath Weapon (Su)**  Although it deals negative energy damage, an umbral dragon’s breath weapon does not heal undead creatures.  

 **Create Shadows (Su)**  Any creature slain by an ancient or older umbral dragon rises as a shadow (if 8 HD or less) or greater shadow (if above 8 HD) under the umbral dragon’s control 1d4 rounds later.  

 **Energy Drain (Su)**  A great wyrm umbral dragon deals 1 negative level with each successful bite or claw attack (1 level, DC 32).  

 **Ghost Bane (Su)**  A young or older umbral dragon’s physical attacks deal damage to incorporeal creatures normally.  

 **Shadow Breath (Su)**  Three times per day, an adult or older umbral dragon can breathe a cone of shadows. Creatures who fail a Fortitude save are blinded for 1d4 rounds and take 1 point of Str drain per age category possessed by the dragon. A successful save negates the blindness and reduces Str drain to 1d4 points.  

 **Umbral Scion (Ex)**  Umbral dragons have negative energy affinity and are immune to energy drain and death effects.

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
